Design notes

Purpose

Let a participant hand a call to a coworker who wasn't there. The link is the call's own URL; the share record is what opens it.

Behavior

  • Combobox searches people who have signed in; typing a full @acme.co address works for someone who hasn't signed in yet — the share waits for their first sign-in.
  • Primary action adds the person and copies the link, since the next step is always "paste it to them".
  • Participants can't be removed. A share can be removed by whoever granted it.
  • Grantees see this dialog read-only (no Add) — see open question Q2.

Scope

MVP. Claim U8. Emailing/Slacking the link automatically is Post-MVP (Slack integration).

Implementation

shadcn-svelte: Dialog, Combobox (Command + Popover), Avatar, Badge, Button, Input Group, Separator, Sonner toast. skgo Command shareCall(callId, email) inserts shares(call_id, grantee_email, grantee_user_id?, granted_by); refuses unless caller is a participant and email is in ALLOWED_DOMAIN. Refreshes the call's access query. Live grantees get a call.shared event on their announcement stream.
